s.note: Jay and Bob thumbing a ride across the country
s.how: Mix 50g soft butter with 1 crushed garlic clove. Grate 150g cheddar and 100g pepper jack or tasty cheese. Drain and chop 3 tbsp pickled jalapeños. Fill 8 slices of sourdough with the cheeses and jalapeños, spread garlic butter on the outsides and cook in a pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melting. Cut into fingers and serve with 150g tomato relish stirred with a pinch of smoked paprika.

s.n: Craft service grilled fruit with chilli lime
s.note: the craft service table on the Hollywood studio lot
s.how: Cut half a pineapple, a quarter of a rockmelon and a wedge of watermelon into thick spears. Heat a grill pan or barbecue very hot and char the pineapple and rockmelon 1 to 2 minutes a side, leaving the watermelon raw. Mix 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp chilli powder and the zest of 1 lime. Stir 200g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp honey, lime juice and chopped mint. Arrange the fruit, sprinkle with chilli lime salt and serve with the dip.

m.note: the fast food stop on the way west
m.how: Roll 600g beef mince into 8 balls and smash flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, add American cheese and cook 1 minute more. Stack 2 patties per toasted bun with pickles and 4 tbsp mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce, then wrap in paper.

w.note: Suzanne, the orangutan they bust out
w.how: Split 4 bananas lengthways into 4 dishes. Add a scoop each of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge and pour over. Top with whipped cream, chopped peanuts and a cherry.

d.note: the drinks machine at the Quick Stop
d.how: Blend 200ml raspberry cordial with 600g ice, 200ml cold water and the juice of 1 lemon until smooth and slushy. Pour into 4 big cups and serve straight away with straws.
